title: Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) - Boulder, CO
description:
Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) $62 K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.

• Inclusive, socially responsible, clie

title: English-Chinese Bilingual Voice Recording - AI Trainer
description:
This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You talk, you get paid.
About the Role
We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.
Do you switch between English and Chinese mid-sentence without even thinking about it? Rant about your day, discuss your favorite show, think out loud with different languages - say it exactly how you'd say it to a friend. What if you could get paid just for recording it?
Responsibilities:

• Record 1-2 minute voice clips responding to a prompt or reacting to a short video

• Speak naturally, switching between English and Chinese the way you normally would in everyday conversation

• Complete a few clips per recording session

Requirements

• Language: Fully bilingual - fluent or native in both English and Chinese, and someone who naturally mixes the two when speaking

• Equipment: Any device works, including your phone - no studio or special equipment needed

• Recording environment: A quiet room with no background music, TV, traffic, or other people talking

• Audio quality: Clear voice, close to the mic, one speaker only, no echo. A headset or earbuds with a mic helps but isn't required

• Note: Quiet, clean audio matters most - background noise or unclear speech can affect approval

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

• Get paid to talk - no perfect grammar, no formality: earn up to $30/hour depending on your pace and approval rate

• Do it from your couch, your phone, wherever's comfortable

• Flexible, from home, paid per approved recording

• If you naturally mix Chinese and English when you speak, you're exactly who we're looking for

Our Vision: Unlock Healthcare's Full Capacity

Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.

OUR VALUES

Enterprise Solutions exists to make that complexity scalable. Success means fewer deployments delayed by technical readiness, tighter alignment between what Growth sells and what Post-Sales can deliver, and a team that becomes increasingly technically self-sufficient because the hardest problems you solve become playbooks, tools, and repeatable capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Partner with Growth to lead technical discovery and deep dives with hospital IT leadership, ensuring architecture, integration requirements, limitations, dependencies, and customer responsibilities are understood before commitments are made. Help solution net-new integrations and technical workflows as our customers' needs evolve.

- Build technical leverage across Vitalize. Equip Growth, Deployments, Support, and Customer Success with the knowledge, documentation, training, and tools to independently handle increasingly complex technical workflows and customer conversations.

title: LinkedIn Exec Content Writer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a LinkedIn executive content writer to run our executive content program for two brands: Darkroom, our growth marketing agency, and Shadow, our AI commerce platform. Ad Age recently described us as "if Omnicom was rebuilt on AI." Our buyers, founders and operators, spend their professional attention on LinkedIn, and our executives reach more of them than any company page.

You make our executives sound like themselves, consistently, every week. You interview them, write for them, plan what each of them posts, and edit until it reads like a person, not a brand. Team members who want to post get your help too.

This is a remote role, hiring in Brazil, Portugal or Spain only, working with a team in the EST Time Zone, and all business is conducted 100% in English.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- The Executive Content Program: Run it day to day across our executive team, so every account has a clear voice, a plan and a steady rhythm.

- Voice Interviews: Recorded interviews with executives that become posts close to their own words.

- Context Files: A living file for every executive: voice, expertise, stories and the lines they won't cross, built from calls, talks and interviews.

- Ghostwriting: Ideas, drafts, edits and approvals for executive posts, end to end.

- The Executive Calendar: One calendar across all executive accounts. You decide who posts for each launch and keep topics from colliding.

- Launch Days: Coordinate executive posts around launches, webinars and events so the accounts reinforce each other.

- Formats: Text posts, carousels, short video clip scripts, and posts repurposed from talks and appearances.

- Editing: Every draft gets a human edit. Marketing speak comes out; the person's voice stays in.

- Reading What Works: Track which topics, formats and voices reach our buyers, and feed it back into the calendar.

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

- You have ghostwritten for founders or executives on LinkedIn, and the posts sounded like them. Send links.

- You understand B2B buyers making considered decisions.

- You know commerce and growth well enough to write about DTC, performance marketing, retention and AI tooling without a briefing.

- You can interview a busy executive for 20 minutes and leave with a week of posts, in several distinct voices.

- You are a sharp editor who cuts marketing speak and keeps a person's voice.

- You know LinkedIn formats and distribution: hooks, carousels, native video, comments.

- You already work with Claude, ChatGPT, or similar daily for research and ideas, and you know where AI stops and editing starts.

HARD DISQUALIFIERS

- No ghostwriting samples for executives or founders.

- Copy that reads like marketing, not like a person.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace-we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Production Quality Control Specialist
description:
Quality Control Specialist

Department: Production

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours/week)

About Drips

Drips engages people in two-way, compliance-governed SMS conversations - the kind that get responses, drive action, and close the gaps traditional outreach leaves open.

In practice, that means Drips helps organizations connect with their customers through large-scale, automated text and phone campaigns. Our proprietary platform lets clients design conversations, schedule outreach, and route responses so the right messages reach the right people at the right time.

The Quality Control Specialist role is what confirms those campaigns actually work the way they're supposed to before real customers ever see them.

Role Overview

As a Quality Control Specialist, you test our product. You take completed builds and verify, end to end, that they behave the way they're supposed to in real-world conditions - not just that the settings look right on screen, but that messages send on time, calls route correctly, and the experience holds up once it's live. You'll manage a steady queue of cases moving through QC, prioritizing your work so nothing sits and nothing slips through untested.

You will:

• Run functional and regression tests on completed builds to confirm they perform as intended - checking timing, routing, message content, and call behavior against real-world scenarios.

• Own a queue of QC cases from intake through completion, picking up work once Build has finished configuring it and seeing each case all the way through to a clean, documented close.

• Identify, document, and communicate defects clearly, so the right fix gets made by the right team without back-and-forth guessing.

This role calls for a bit more technical depth than some other Production roles - you'll want a real grasp of how the system behaves and why, not just how to click through it.

What You’ll Do

Execute Functional & Regression Testing

• Test completed campaign builds end to end: message timing and sequencing, call routing, audio playback, and digit-press behavior.

• Verify that changes behave correctly across real-world conditions - different carriers, devices, and time zones - not just in an idealized test case.

• Run regression tests to confirm that a fix or change hasn't broken something else in the process.

Own a Queue of QC Cases

• Manage a steady flow of cases moving into QC once Build has finished its work, prioritizing based on urgency, launch dates, and complexity.

• See each case through from intake to a fully tested, documented close - you're the last check before something goes live.

• Keep the queue moving without letting cases stall or pile up.

Partner with Build and Product Engineering

• Coordinate directly with the Build team when a case needs rework, giving them clear, specific detail on what didn't pass and why.

• Work with Product Engineering when an issue traces back to the underlying system rather than a specific campaign configuration.

• Translate technical findings into plain language so both technical and non-technical partners understand what was found and what it means.

Document and Report on Quality

• Document test cases and results in a test management platform, so there's a clear record of what was tested and how it performed.

• Maintain a dashboard of defect results to track trends and flag recurring problem areas.

• Deliver regular reports to leadership summarizing findings, risks, and improvement opportunities.

Examples of Day-to-Day Tasks

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute.

It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

 

Responsibilities and Duties

We are seeking a highly skilled System Tests & Diagnostics Engineer  to develop, extend, and integrate specialized silicon validation and diagnostics tools for next-generation AI SoCs.

Unlike traditional validation roles focused on executing test plans, this position is responsible for developing the diagnostic software and stress tools that expose hardware failures, characterize silicon behavior, and improve platform observability throughout bring-up and validation.

You will work closely with Arm engineers to understand and extend existing diagnostics technologies while developing Graphcore-specific capabilities for future AI hardware.

You will work with existing Arm-developed diagnostics technologies and extend them to support Graphcore's next-generation AI silicon.

This role requires close collaboration with hardware architects, firmware engineers, validation engineers, and diagnostics teams to understand new hardware capabilities and translate them into reusable diagnostic software.

• Build reusable validation utilities that integrate into the existing validation framework.

• Design configuration-driven diagnostics supporting scalable parameterization and workload variation.

• Collaborate with hardware architects to understand new hardware capabilities and identify missing diagnostics.

• Work closely with firmware and validation teams to improve hardware observability.

• Debug low-level hardware, firmware, operating system, and driver interactions.

• Analyze diagnostic output and improve fault isolation methodologies.

• Develop software that enables engineers to reproduce and investigate difficult hardware failures.

• Contribute reusable libraries and utilities that improve engineering productivity across multiple validation teams.

title: Audio Annotation Analyst
description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time - protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do
As an Audio Annotation Analyst on the Research team, you will review and annotate audio recordings, video content, and associated interaction data to support the development, evaluation, and improvement of Pindrop 's fraud detection, authentication, and deepfake detection technologies. Your assignments will span audio and video annotation projects based on evolving Research priorities and team needs.
Your primary responsibility will be to produce accurate, consistent, and high-quality annotations across a variety of Research projects. You will also support targeted investigations by reviewing interactions, identifying anomalies, and documenting observations that help Research Scientists better understand model performance and real-world customer interactions.
You will…

• Review and annotate audio recordings, video content, and associated interaction data, assigning accurate labels based on project-specific guidelines and classification criteria.

• Apply established classification criteria to identify potential fraud indicators, authentication outcomes, characteristics of human-generated versus synthetic content, and other attributes relevant to Research projects, including intent recognition when applicable.

• Apply annotation guidelines consistently across large datasets, review existing labels for discrepancies, and help maintain high-quality datasets for model development and evaluation.

• Flag interactions that are difficult to classify or fall outside established guidelines, document observations, and collaborate with Research Scientists to resolve edge cases.

• Support Research investigations by reviewing audio and video interactions to identify potential issues such as background noise, audio quality degradation, IVR process gaps, or unexpected model behavior.

• Conduct targeted interaction and metadata reviews to support customer inquiries, model evaluations, and evolving Research priorities.

• Maintain accurate annotation records and summarize findings, recurring patterns, and classification inconsistencies to support Research analysis and model improvements.

• Handle sensitive audio, video, and interaction data responsibly, following established privacy, security, and confidentiality guidelines.

Who you are
You are…

• Exceptionally attentive to detail, with strong listening and observational skills to identify subtle differences in audio, video, and interactions.

• Comfortable with focused, repetitive review work and able to maintain accuracy and consistency across large volumes of data.

• Able to follow detailed guidelines while exercising sound judgment when encountering ambiguous or unfamiliar situations.

• Organized, self-driven, and able to document classification decision

title: Senior Credit Risk Manager
description:
Position Title: Senior Credit Risk Manager
Department: Credit Risk
Reports to: Global CTO
Location: Remote #APJ #EMEA
About FINN

FINN is a fintech company building simple and transparent products that improve financial well-being for underbanked employees. Our core offering gives people access to wages they have already earned, alongside tools to help them manage money better, build savings, access insurance, earn additional income, and use fairer financial services.
Founded in 2022, FINN is the largest player in the early wage access space in Southeast Asia and is expanding rapidly into new markets globally. We are looking for ambitious builders who take ownership, move fast, and want to shape products that create meaningful impact in people’s lives.
We’re seeking a Credit Risk Manager to shape our ML-driven underwriting strategy and strengthen our risk decisioning across Southeast Asia . In this role, you’ll combine analytical depth with hands-on model development to drive smarter, fairer decisions. From monitoring portfolio health to designing and deploying robust credit risk models, you’ll help us balance growth with prudent risk management. Working closely with data, engineering, and product teams, you’ll turn insights into business impact and improve approval funnels, refining policies, and expanding access to credit responsibly.
Risk Analysis

• Monitor key risk metrics (e.g., default rates, approval rates) and investigate significant changes.

• Analyze large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement in risk management processes.

• Simulate the impact of credit policy or model changes, support A/B tests, and help guide rollouts to improve approval funnel performance.

• Track performance post-implementation and refine strategies using feedback loops and business KPIs.

Model Development & Monitoring

• Develop, test, and deploy risk models in an iterative, agile manner.

• Monitor the performance of risk models, tracking feature stability, accuracy, and drift over time.

• Understand country-specific factors such as onboarding processes, customer limit management, and local alternative data sources.

• Collaborate with internal and external data vendors to evaluate and integrate new data sources.

• Contribute to the setup of early warning signals for portfolio deterioration, using a mix of quantitative and qualitative data.

Your Profile:
Required:

• At least 5 years of experience in consumer credit risk analysis

• Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, actuarial studies, computer science or another relevant field

• Demonstrated proficiency in consumer credit risk assessment and how it relatesto other business units (marketing, engineering, finance, and legal)

• Hands-on experience building, testing, deploying, and monitoring credit risk models (e.g., logistic regression, XGBoost, scorecards)

• Good statistical and mathematical skills

• Good working knowledge of SQL and Python

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

• Able to communicate complex credit risk concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

• Independent, creative, and proactive problem-solving mindset

Bonus:

• Previous experience in a fintech, neobank, or digital lending environment

• Able to design and deploy data marts and alerts

• Familiarity with credit data sources or regulatory environments in Southeast Asia (e.g., Thailand, Philippines, Indonesia)

• Previous experience with cloud platforms, AWS and GCP

• Experience in the design and automation of credit portfolios or financial reports

• Familiar with model deployment frameworks like Flask/FastAPI or MLflow

• Familiarity with MLOps tooling (e.g., Airflow, dbt, or feature stores)

What we Offer:

• A competitive salary and benefits package

• Flexible work policies: fully remote work or at one of our offices in Singapore or Bangkok

• Boundless opportunity: learn and grow at every stage of your career

• Continuous innovation

title: Head of Sales Excellence & Methodology
locationText: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's sales organization is growing quickly across segments, industries, and geographies, and how we sell has to mature as fast as the team does. We are looking for a Head of Sales Excellence & Methodology to own the substance of sales enablement at Anthropic: the sales methodology itself, the standard for what excellent selling looks like here, and the change management that makes it stick in the field.

You will define a common way of selling that holds up across very different customers, from startups to the largest global enterprises, and then lead the organization through adopting it. That means earning sponsorship from senior sales leadership, equipping frontline managers to coach to the methodology instead of only inspecting for it, and building alongside sellers so the result reflects how deals are really won.

This is a leadership role for someone who has taken a sales organization through real transformation and can show that it changed behavior and results. You will set direction, [build and lead a team], and stay close enough to the field to know when something is not working.

Key responsibilities:

•
Define, document, and evolve Anthropic's sales methodology and process standards, including discovery, qualification, deal strategy, and deal review, so that sellers in every segment and region share a common language

•
Design and run the rollout and reinforcement of methodology changes across the sales organization, securing executive sponsorship and making clear what is expected of each level of sales leadership

•
Equip frontline managers to coach to the methodology in pipeline reviews, deal reviews, and forecasting, so that it becomes part of the operating rhythm

•
Sequence and deliver complex, multi-audience programs across geographies, segments, industries, and roles that scale globally while adapting where local or segment differences matter

•
Develop content, frameworks, and standards together with sellers and sales leaders, testing them on live deals before scaling

•
Define the leading and lagging indicators that show whether the methodology is changing seller behavior and outcomes, and act on what the data shows

•
Partner with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Product, Marketing, and the wider Sales Enablement team so the methodology is reflected in systems, messaging, and day-to-day workflows

•
Apply Claude and internal tooling to personalize coaching and reinforcement, so that quality does not depend on headcount

Minimum qualifications:

•
Practitioner-level expertise in sales methodology and sales process design, including discovery, qualification, deal strategy, deal review, and forecasting

•
Have led a methodology or sales process change across a sales organization, and can show how seller behavior and results changed as a result

•
Have run enablement or sales excellence programs spanning multiple geographies, segments, industries, or roles

•
Have worked directly with senior sales leaders and frontline managers to secure sponsorship for change, including holding a position constructively when they disagreed

•
Have built programs with sellers and sales leaders, testing them on live deals, instead of handing down finished programs

•
Have defined and tracked adoption and impact measures that go beyond completion and satisfaction scores

•
Communicate clearly, in writing and in conversation, with executive audiences

Preferred qualifications:

•
Experience building and leading a team of senior enablement or sales excellence professionals

•
A clear, experience-based view of where common sales methodologies break down in practice

title: Senior Payroll Specialist
description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

ABOUT YOU

LiveKit's team is growing fast, in the US and around the world, and Finance is taking over payroll. You'll be the person who makes it run: every employee, every state, every country, every filing.
Most senior payroll roles hand you a well-oiled machine and ask you not to break it. This one asks you to build it. You'll own US and international payroll, set up the calendar and controls, assist with month end close, and be the internal expert on anything that touches a paycheck.

You'll thrive as the Senior Payroll Specialist if you:

- are obsessive about tying out numbers to the penny

- are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

- work hard and can build and ship fast

- are focused on polish, detail and quality

- are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd implement LiveKit, and potentially tinkering with it 😊

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Senior Payroll Specialist at LiveKit, you will:

- Run US and international payroll end to end, from collecting inputs to final reconciliation

- Own all associated payroll tax filings, domestic and international, and keep us compliant and on time

- Manage our PEO and EOR relationships, and know where their responsibility ends and yours begins

- Reconcile payroll to the general ledger each cycle and support month-end close

- Build and maintain our payroll calendar, processes, and documentation as payroll moves into Finance

- Partner with People/Talent and accounting on new hires, changes, terminations, and month-end reconciliation

- Support equity administration in Carta and equity reporting for the board

- Be the go-to contact for payroll questions internally and for auditor requests externally

WHO YOU ARE

- Hands-on experience running both US and international payroll, including Canada and/or the EU

- Experience managing payroll tax filings directly, not just handing them off to a provider

- Experience with multi-state US payroll for a remote, distributed team

- Strong experience working within PEO and/or EOR structures

- Familiarity with startup-focused platforms such as Rippling, Deel, Remote, or similar

- Comfort working independently as the subject-matter expert, juggling many moving pieces and flagging tax, legal, and compliance risk before it becomes a problem

NICE TO HAVE

- CPP, FPC, or a similar payroll certification

- Experience moving payroll in-house, switching providers, or migrating an HRIS

- Experience with equity administration in Carta

- Experience at a fast-growing company with a distributed, international team

- You've personally caught a payroll error before anyone else did, and you still think about it fondly

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

- An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

- Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Health, dental, and vision benefits

- Flexible vacation policy

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

title: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) - Pueblo, CO
description:
Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner ( PMHNP-BC ) $115k - $135k/year

Position Requirement: Full - Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Pueblo, Colorado

Salary:

115K - 135K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

• No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

• Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.

• Typically, clinicians work between Mondays - Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff

title: Principal Sales Engineer
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
Job Description Summary:
Vertica delivers a high-performance MPP columnar database engineered for large-scale analytics across on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments with flexibility of cloud-native architecture. Our mission is to help organizations accelerate insight, reduce cost, and make data-driven decisions with confidence.
As a Presales Solutions Consultant, you will play a key role in demonstrating how the Vertica can simplify complex data challenges, optimize workloads, and meet the performance, governance, and sovereignty requirements of enterprises across South Korea.
You will partner closely with Account Executives, engage directly with customers, and guide them through technical evaluation, architecture design, and proof-of-concept success. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role suited to someone who enjoys solving real problems and shaping data platform strategies. The Impact You Will Have

•
Establish trusted technical relationships with customers across your assigned Korea territory, working in tandem with Account Executives to deliver successful customer outcomes.

• Act as a technical expert in large-scale analytics , showcasing how Vertica’s architecture, performance model, and hybrid capabilities solve customers’ most demanding workloads.

• Lead solution design, POCs, demos, performance analysis, and cost optimization to support adoption of Vertica.

• Produce reference architecture, best-practice guides, workshops, and technical enablement materials for both customers and internal teams.

• Represent Vertica within the regional community by hosting technical sessions, meetups, hands-on labs, and industry-focused discussions .

• Develop deep expertise as a technical or industry specialist (e.g., Financial Services, Telco, Public Sector, Retail/CPG, Manufacturing, or Data Platform Modernization).

•
Experience for the other players in the market (Teradata, Oracle, Netezza, Snowflake, Databricks or Hadoop)

What You Will Do (Responsibilities)
1. Technical Sales Leadership

• Own technical discovery, requirements analysis, scoping, solution design, and POC execution.

• Present architecture options clearly across audiences-from CTO/CIO stakeholders to data engineers and architects.

2. Architecture & Performance

• Optimize analytical workloads through projection design, partitioning, resource management, Eon Mode scaling, and cost/performance tuning.

• Design and validate migration strategies from legacy EDWs, cloud data warehouses, and Hadoop/Spark-based environments.

3. Platform Integration

• Integrate Vertica with Kafka, Spark, DBT, Airflow, ETL, and BI/AI ecosystems .

• Architect hybrid or multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP), including networking, object storage (S3/GCS/ADLS), and Kubernetes-based operations via Vertica DB Operator .

4. Security, Governance & Compliance

• Advise on RBAC, encryption, auditing, masking/tokenization, private networking , and data governance controls.

• Support customers navigating Korean data sovereignty requirements , including APRA CPS-234, government frameworks, and regulated industry best practice.

5. Evangelism & Enablement

• Deliver workshops, hands-on labs, performance deep dives, and industry-aligned solution briefs.

• Support partner ecosystem enablement across SI, CSP, and ISV relationships.

What We Look For (Qualifications)

• Strong experience engaging customers in technical sales or solution architecture roles, ideally in analytics, data platforms, or hybrid cloud solutions.

• Ability to context-switch between business value conversations and deep technical discussions.

• Hands-on experience with large-scale SQL analytics , data modelling, workload optimization, and POC delivery.

• Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming/scripting language (Python, Java, Scala, Bash, etc.).

• Practical experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP , including network,
